name: brief-global
description: Account-free, source-linked public feed for global policy intelligence.

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server/publicServer.ts --platform=node --packages=external --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild server/refreshWorker.ts --platform=node --packages=external --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/worker.js && esbuild server/workspaceWorker.ts --platform=node --packages=external --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/workspaceWorker.js
scripts.lint: prettier --check README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md TRADEMARK.md docs deploy render.yaml supabase/migrations scripts client/index.html client/src server package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
